title: compodocx documentation.json, schema 6
description: Written by `compodocx --exportFormat json`. Generated from src/app/interfaces/export-data.interface.ts; see docs/json-export.md for the version history and the compatibility policy.

generatedAt.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was generated.
Volatile - listed in `VOLATILE_EXPORT_FIELDS`; strip before byte-equal diffs.

compodocxVersion.description:
Version of `@cngxjs/compodocx` that produced this snapshot.
Volatile - listed in `VOLATILE_EXPORT_FIELDS`; strip before byte-equal diffs.

services.description: Classes decorated with Angular's `@Service`; written only when there are any.

routes.description: Written only when the route model has routes and routes are not disabled.

styleSources.description:
Style sources of the documented components, keyed by project-relative
file path, or `<component file>#inline-<n>` for inline styles. Each
component lists its keys in `themeStyleSources`.

styleFiles.description:
Free-standing style files matched by `styleFiles` that have documented
content. Their sources are in `styleSources`, keyed by file.

semantic.description:
Entry points and counts of the semantic analysis. Absent when the
analysis did not run (no tsconfig, or the tsconfig could not be read).

additionalPages.description: Pages from `--includes`, in sidebar order; written only when there are any.

slug.description: Slug path below the includes folder, forward slashes ("guides/getting-started").

label.description: Sidebar label; written only when it differs from the title.

file.description: Source file relative to the includes folder, forward slashes.

markdown.description: Raw Markdown as written, not the rendered HTML.

aiGenerated.description: The page carries the `@aiGenerated` marker (its detail text stays in `markdown`).

ExportAxis.description: A declared classification axis: every declared value with its symbol count.

unclassified.description: Symbols of the axis' kinds without a value.

ExportCallSignature.description: A call signature of an interface (`(value: T): number`), listed with its properties.

storybookUrl.description: External documentation links injected by JSDoc tags.

entryPoint.description: Import path of the nearest barrel that exports the symbol.

exportedBy.description: Import paths of every barrel that exports the symbol, sorted.

notExported.description: Exported from its file, inside an entry point, but in no barrel.

feature.description: The feature the symbol belongs to; `key` `''` is the entry point's root feature.

axes.description: Values on the declared classification axes, by axis name.

routedAt.description: Components: full paths of the routes rendering it.

mountedAt.description: Route array variables: full paths of the places a router mounts it at.

providers.description: A provider written as a call (`provideFoo(withBar())`) also carries `call`.

exampleUrls.description: URLs of the `<example-url>` tags in the entry's own JSDoc, relative ones behind `exampleUrlBase`.

themeStyleSources.description: Keys into the top-level `styleSources` map, in collection order.

breaking.description: Text of the `@breaking` tag; `''` without one.

ExportJsdocTag.description:
A JSDoc tag of a class, member or parameter as the crawler writes it. Most
entries are the TypeScript JSDoc node itself, so node fields (`pos`, `end`,
`kind`, `flags`, ...) can appear next to the fields listed here. Those node
fields are deprecated since 0.12.0 and go with schema 7.

HostDirectiveEntry.description:
Structured representation of a single entry from a
`@Component({ hostDirectives: [...] })` array. The render layer
(`MetadataHostDirectivesRow` in `MetadataRow.tsx`) reads `name`, `inputs`
and `outputs`. `unresolved` lets the renderer optionally mark entries
whose identifier could not be traced back to an object literal or
directive class; `refName` preserves the original identifier text of a
dereferenced entry for attribution if we ever want to surface it.

unresolved.description: True if `name` is an unresolved identifier - no matching directive class or local const.

refName.description: Original identifier text when the entry was dereferenced from a local const.

ProviderCall.description: A provider written as a call: `provideFoo(withBar())` or `...provideFoo()`.

args.description: Callee names of the arguments that are calls (feature functions); others are dropped.

ProviderEntry.description:
Structured representation of a single entry in a `providers: [...]` array.

The top-level `name` and `type` fields are preserved for backwards
compatibility with every existing downstream consumer (`application.ts`
filter, dependencies engine relationships, JSON/PDF exports, menu helpers).
`name` is the `provide:` target for object providers, or the class / token
identifier for bare providers. `type` is derived from a substring match on
the name via `getType(name)` and may be further refined by
`application.ts` when the provider matches a known Injectable or
Interceptor in the dep-engine registry.

The remaining fields are additive and consumed by the render layer
(`ProvidersSection`) to show the provider strategy.

name.description: `provide:` target for object providers, else the class / token name.

type.description: Derived from `getType(name)` or set later by `application.ts`.

kind.description: Which DI pattern this provider uses.

provide.description: Same as `name` for object providers, omitted for `kind: 'class'`.

useValue.description: Source text of the useValue expression. See `valueKind` for category.

factory.description: Identifier name of the factory function.

deps.description: Identifier names of factory dependencies, in source order.

call.description:
Set when the entry is a call (`provideFoo(withBar())`) or a spread of
one: the callee and the callee names of the arguments that are calls.
`name` keeps the printed source.

StyleMixin.description: An SCSS mixin or function documented with a `///` block.

content.description: `@content` description; null when the tag is absent.

StyleMixinParam.description: One parameter of a documented SCSS mixin or function.

default.description: From `@param [default]`, else the signature default, else ''.

kind.description:
Source kind - drives rendering and the prefix in the name column.
`css-hook` is a property the component reads but never sets; it exists
only because a `@cssprop` tag names it.

description.description: Markdown description (everything before the tag block)

file.description: Source location for "view in source" link
